svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Power distribution + servo bus
svg.desc: Functional interface drawing: regulator, clamp, fuse, enable-gate and bus-adapter circuits remain to select. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.
svg.text: Functional interface drawing: regulator, clamp, fuse, enable-gate and bus-adapter circuits remain to select.
Rev A | 03 OCT 2026 | Drawn from vendor pinouts + Hux GPIO proposal
See docs/wiring-atlas.md for source links, interface decisions and verification boundaries.
Opens positive feed to all actuators
Use VIN; VM is protected bus access
Feeds both encoder BLUE leads at 5 V
Check loaded voltage and USB backfeed
GP20 p26 TX → interface TX input
GP21 p27 RX ← interface RX output
GP10 p14 + GP22 p29 → hardware gate
Gate output → BOTH wheel SLEEP pins.
Physical cut must remove wheel + servo power.
All GND symbols join this reference. Route high-current returns away from sensor / MCU wiring.
Both CS inputs need ADC protection.
Check input range and power-off injection.
